capabilities.justification: Connects only to the built-in v0 api.github.com endpoint to read the configured Pages source ref and ownership manifests, create immutable Git objects, and advance that ref with a non-forced atomic update.
Resolves the single built-in v0 GitHub API hostname before connecting on port 443.
Reads wall-clock time only to interpret an HTTP-date Retry-After response from GitHub.
Sleeps between bounded retries for rate limits and transient pre-publication API failures.

justification: Publishes one exact owned prefix of a GitHub Pages source branch through GitHub's Git Data API while preserving sibling owners. Credential selection and environment access belong to the composing FM07 CLI in FM-B047.
